connectorUiConfig.title: Recorded Future - Playbook Alerts (Codeless Connector)
connectorUiConfig.descriptionMarkdown: Imports [Recorded Future Playbook Alerts](https://support.recordedfuture.com/hc/en-us/articles/13152506878739-Playbook-Alerting-Rules) into the `RecordedFuturePlaybookAlerts_V2_CL` table using the Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework (CCF). Replaces the `RecordedFuture-Playbook-Alert-Importer` Logic App. Requires the Recorded Future Data Connectors infrastructure (DCE, DCRs and tables) to be deployed in the workspace resource group first (see the **Recorded Future - Log Ingestion** connector).

sampleQueries.description: Latest state of each playbook alert

dataTypes.name: RecordedFuturePlaybookAlerts_V2_CL
dataTypes.lastDataReceivedQuery:
RecordedFuturePlaybookAlerts_V2_CL
| summarize Time = max(TimeGenerated)
| where isnotempty(Time)

resourceProvider.permissionsDisplayText: Read and Write permissions are required.

customs.name: Recorded Future Data Connectors infrastructure
customs.description: The shared DCE `recorded-future-dce` and DCR `recorded-future-dcr-playbook-alerts` must exist, with exactly these names, in the same resource group as the workspace. The names are fixed and not configurable. Deploy them with Step 1 of the **Recorded Future - Log Ingestion** connector.

customs.name: Recorded Future API Token
customs.description: A Recorded Future API token with access to Playbook Alerts.

instructionSteps.title: 1. Disable the Logic App importer
instructionSteps.description: If the `RecordedFuture-Playbook-Alert-Importer` Logic App is running, disable it before connecting, otherwise alerts are imported twice.

instructionSteps.title: 2. Configure
instructionSteps.description:
Enter your Recorded Future API token. Filters are optional comma-separated lists; leave empty to import everything. Values are case-sensitive and must match exactly, e.g. `High,Moderate`.

Categories: `code_repo_leakage`, `domain_abuse`, `identity_novel_exposures`, `third_party_risk`, `cyber_vulnerability`, `dark_web`, `malicious_sites`, `socmed_impersonation`.

Priorities: `High`, `Moderate`, `Informational`.

Statuses: `New`, `InProgress`, `Dismissed`, `Resolved`.

instructionSteps.title: 3. Connect
instructionSteps.description: Make sure the `RecordedFuture-Playbook-Alert-Importer` Logic App is disabled first to avoid duplicate alerts. Then start polling Recorded Future every hour.
